classification.difficultyReason: Independently count repeated wire lengths and choose a workable numerical scale across their range, preserving unequal gaps between observed lengths. Link those frequencies to dot stacks without an intermediate table being requested.

inlines.text: The following 21 values are the measurements (in centimetres) of lengths of wire.

answer.worked:
Use an evenly spaced numerical axis labelled Length of wire (centimetres). Place one dot for each measurement, stacking repeated measurements vertically.

The frequencies are: 311: 3; 321: 3; 353: 2; 361: 1; 367: 3; 371: 4; 379: 2; 387: 1; 405: 2. These total 21 dots.

spec.description: Complete dot plot with an evenly spaced numerical axis and vertically stacked dots at every observed wire length.
